steps.text: Part 4 of 4: The knight in a busy position, on the edge and in the corner. This part covers Check yourself. Each part is short on purpose: finish one, play a game or take a break, and come back.
Six checks with no hints are next. Count the exits first, then ask of each landing square what attacks it. A knight that has exits but no safe ones is in as much trouble as one with none.

steps.prompt: Explain to a friend how to count a knight's jumps: what you cross out, what you keep, and one warning. Write it in your own words before you read on.

steps.text: **Check your explanation.** Did you say that the knight jumps in an L; that you cross out squares off the board and squares with your own pieces; that you keep captures; that pieces between never block; that edge and corner knights have fewer jumps; and that you check what attacks the landing square? Add whatever you missed.

steps.prompt: Which part did you leave out or hesitate over? What will you look at first next time? (optional)
